releaseNotes:
• Fix: Daylight & Night Clothed Kissing Detection — removed negation phrases from MobileCLIP negative prompts that crushed kissing margins, added broader romantic/clothed kissing positives, and fell back to body boxes when faces are in profile or shadow.
• Fix: Visual-First -> Audio-When-Unclear Gate — audio only triggers when visuals are dark, occluded, missing, or borderline instead of firing over clearly safe scenes.
• Fix: Continuous +10s Skip Until Normal Scene — added post-skip 140ms verification and continuation thresholds so >30s intimate scenes keep skipping +10s smoothly until transitioning to normal scenes.
